mapper.select: SELECT * FROM payment_record WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_record (order_id, payment_no, amount, status, pay_channel, pay_time, finish_time) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{paymentNo}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{payChannel}, #{payTime}, #{finishTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE payment_record SET status = #{status}, pay_time = CASE WHEN #{payTime} IS NOT NULL THEN #{payTime} ELSE pay_time END, finish_time = CASE WHEN #{finishTime} IS NOT NULL THEN #{finishTime} ELSE finish_time END WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
